name_en: Global: Anthropic criticised over aggressive web scraping and robots.txt evasion
description: Im Juli/August 2024 warfen Betreiber:innen großer Websites Anthropic vor, ihr ClaudeBot-Crawler ignoriere Robots.txt-Direktiven und schädige durch hohe Lasten den Betrieb. Die Reparatur-Plattform iFixit berichtete laut 404 Media von fast einer Million Crawler-Zugriffen innerhalb von 24 Stunden, die Alarme auslösten und Personal nachts weckten. Freelancer.com-CEO Matt Barrie meldete 3,5 Millionen Zugriffe in vier Stunden und nannte Anthropic den 'mit Abstand aggressivsten' KI-Scraper. Anthropic versicherte, Robots.txt zu respektieren, und ClaudeBot beendete das Crawling von iFixit nach Anpassung der Datei.

description_en: In July and August 2024, operators of high-traffic websites accused Anthropic of running a crawler (ClaudeBot) that ignored robots.txt directives and overloaded their infrastructure. The repair platform iFixit, via 404 Media, reported nearly one million crawler hits within 24 hours, triggering alerts and waking staff overnight. Freelancer.com CEO Matt Barrie reported 3.5 million hits in four hours, calling Anthropic 'by far the most aggressive' AI scraper. Anthropic said it respected robots.txt and stopped crawling iFixit once iFixit updated the file.
